lessons.correction: Continue developing your economy and technology while strengthening your ground army. Maintain current defense and production.
lessons.mistake: Expanding too greedily without proper defenses, or committing to an attack before your economy is stable.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if enemy shows signs of heavy pressure or tech switch (e.g., Mutalisks).
lessons.title: Avoid greedy expansion without defense
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 4 minutes, with heavy economy and production, ground forces (Marine, Reaper), and heavy tech. Enemy is on a ground macro posture with Zergling/Queen, moderate production, and light tech.
lessons.why: Your heavy tech and economy give you a long-term advantage. By continuing to develop, you can outscale the Zerg if they remain on a passive macro path.

lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army and increase technology. Maintain economy and defense.
lessons.mistake: Over-investing in air without proper scouting, or neglecting upgrades.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if enemy shows signs of air transition or heavy pressure.
lessons.title: Avoid over-investing in air without scouting
lessons.when: Midgame, around 9 minutes, with heavy economy and production, Siege Tanks, Marines, and Hellions. Enemy is on a ground macro posture with Zergling/Queen, heavy production and tech.
lessons.why: Your Siege Tank-based army is strong against ground Zerg. Increasing tech will give you an edge in engagements.

lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army and increase technology. Maintain economy and defense.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to an attack before you have a solid army composition and upgrades, or neglecting scouting to detect tech switches.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if enemy shows signs of heavy pressure or tech switch.
lessons.title: Avoid over-committing to attack without solid composition
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 5-6 minutes, with heavy economy and production, Marines, Reapers, and Hellions. Enemy is on a ground macro posture with Zergling/Queen, moderate production and tech.
lessons.why: Hellions are effective against Zerglings and provide map control. Continuing to tech up will give you a strong midgame.
